_single_run_gate_note: Quarantined from the single-run gate (gotcha 10): the reverse_report_* assertions ride on Gemini emitting a parseable, fully-cited report run-to-run, which it does not do reliably even after re-rolls — it red-gated unrelated PRs #336/#340/#342. All its assertions are quality (critical=False), so quarantine fully de-gates it; the case still runs and eval-flake.yml still tracks it.
description: First 07x case — exercises the REVERSE_REPORT contract (HELIXIS_AGENT__REVERSE_REPORT, off by default) on a clean Buildium read. With the flag on (input.reverse_report=true), the Buildium agent must emit a parseable REVERSE_REPORT before replying, with at least one OBSERVED fact each cited to its tool source. Mirrors 040's read path; the property mock carries a numeric id so the agent can cite it per the buildium addendum. (Confidence-calibration is deliberately NOT asserted here: whether the model populates `inferred` — which caps the ceiling — varies run to run, so a calibration assertion would be a flaky hard gate; the citation + observation discipline is the stable contract surface to gate on.)

input.user_message: Look up the rental property 'Maple Court Apartments' in Buildium and tell me about it.
